contentText: Did Trump back down because Europe was tough, or was it because of Europe's willingness to negotiate? FRANCE 24's Brussels correspondent Dave Keating explains that 'EU leaders are not in agreement about the narrative of the past several days and that's going to be a problem because they need to decide tonight whether to make preparations for the anti-coercion instrument to use in case Donald Trump decides to go ahead with the Greenland threats after all'.
